i'm not one to ♥♥♥♥ on an indie game but i really didnt enjoy this one. most things have a drawback, maybe they can be overcome later in the game but it just feels bad at the start. the visual clarity is awful imo. if you're going to make a bullet heaven in 2026 and its going to look like this, it needs to have a pretty good hook or something really interesting to stand out - not just 20MTD but worse and with less content. if you have absolutely nothing left and you love bullet heavens, sure, otherwise, just go play 20MTD or grind survivors

属于是明目张胆的抄黎明前二十分钟，并且还没抄明白； 1.主角受伤后没有无敌帧，被怪堆围住直接连续掉血原地升天，既不能把怪推开也不能多给零点几秒无敌时间； 2.技能及子弹显示层级有问题，如果出爆炸子弹，爆炸效果会直接把怪盖住，顺带把黑洞也盖住，怪都贴脸上了结果因为爆炸效果完全看不见； 3.汉化不完整，比如生命系选项卡里不止一个选项汉化翻译只有半句话； 4.个别时候上一把暴毙以后，点击重试按钮，结果下一把开局一级直接面对小BOSS，一级没点任何技能就能喜滋滋直面贪吃蛇；

Really fun action roguelike. The intensity ramps up quickly without making you feel helpless. The skills, synergies and weapon upgrades all feel satisfying, and well balanced for the most part. The game is developed by a passionate solo dev, who is actively updating regularly. Well worth the price not only to support the dev, but also if you like this genre of game.
The game is ok. Not really complex and not a lot of rng. A nice game to play a quick run and then close the game here and there.

Great little game in the same vein of 20 Minutes Till Dawn, evoking much of the same vibe but with its own bit of uniqueness. Has a few rough edges here and there - what game doesn't, right? - but the dev is very receptive to feedback and is actively working on the next big update at the time of writing. Definitely worthwhile for the fairly cheap price.
I'm obsessed with this game; the builds are insane; the weapons are great; I love the art style and the music rocks. This is a hidden gem and a perfect Steam Deck game 10/10
This is a really fun bullet heaven roguelike! I've been playing on Steam Deck and it runs great on there. It has fun weapon and build variety as well. Definitely pick this up!

Wonderful game, with an equally understanding developer. I have to say, compared to a vast majority of other games, this one's developer is quite outstanding. Now on to the game. if you like the game "20 Minutes Until Dawn" this one is basically the same thing, with an absurd amount of polish and features added on top. if you like risk of rain, this also scratches that itch. overall I like a difficult game as well, and this game has options that will give you that choice.
Super solid survivors like, the gun feel is super good and the upgrades feel pretty satisfying!
Great game, very fun and addictive!

I've only played for a few hours, but the game already has that "one more run" feeling. The combat is fun, the progression is satisfying, and experimenting with different builds keeps every run interesting. Looking forward to future updates! i love revolver haha
I was promised unlimited weapons, i only got to carry 6 at a time, i was lied to. my life is in ruins, my wife left me, she took the goldfish. I like the game though, so there is that.
Really well done. The quality of the shooting is immediately apparent. It's tons of fun for the small price tag it's completely worth it.

really fun game, performance is really good even when the screen is full of bullets and enemies it really needs more content, there are only 4 different weapon classes and not enough power variations it would benefit for more settings for readability as well, opacity for bullets and pet and some others looking forward to seeing more content as it develops

An interesting stylistic take on this genre. Felt a little thin to start but there have been updates as time has gone that has expanded the play to make sure that future runs don't always feel the same

Pretty cool little game. Works really well on Steam Deck. The only problem is that visibility of enemies quickly becomes an issue with just a few upgrades and there's a lot of bullets on screen. I'd say it's worth the less than $4 I paid for it.
Nothing really innovative and not too big, but if it's not a problem for you then it's an enjoyable game.
Amazing game. Really love the pixel art and all game mechanichs, very very good bullet hell

Haven't played this too much yet, about 2 hours between the demo and the main game, but it's pretty great. It feels more DOOMy than most Bullet Heavens, which I like, and the multiple guns gimmick is pretty great. The 20 Minutes Til Dawn inspiration is pretty clear here, but between the aesthetic and gun builds not feeling underpowered compared to stacking elemental stuff, it's still very much it's own thing and definitely worth the money if you like this genre.

[h1]按左键明明是加速跑，为什么翻译成射击？[/h1] （也许手动开枪模式里左键就是射击，可问题是谁会玩手动开枪呢？）害得我差点把佳作打入冷宫，翻译太过分啦~！ 什么build？那都是天上的浮云，走位躲敌人、躲子弹才是这款游戏的灵魂。是的你没看错，别看预告片各种花里胡哨射击洗礼，实际玩起来你会被N多个四面八方袭来的杂兵追着跑，夹缝生存才是王道。而且游戏数值调试的很优秀，先不说各种道具升级搭配的可挖掘性高不高，至少在前期无论你选择什么样的构筑都被逼得刚刚好勉强通关。游戏局外提供个了武器升级以及被动符文的解锁和佩戴，目测到了后期会变成纯粹的爽游。 [h1]画风极其简单的游戏，玩起来却一点不简单并且很上头。[/h1]
Great combat flow and tons of player choice in builds! Slingshot + Bounce was my favorite combo!

This game is a blast to play. Difficulty ramp is good, graphic presentation is unique, upgrades are satisfying, weapons are good. Don't sleep on this one, support indies...you'll never regret supporting awesome creativity. Highly recommended to anyone who loves the 'Survivors' (Bullet Heaven) genera. P.S. Runs fantastically on both Steam Deck and Linux desktop gaming PC.
Nice roguelite, loads of red, loads of enemies; really have to level up to keep on going, but really awesome!
If you're a fan of Vampire Survivers and the genre, you'll enjoy Echoes of Red!
USteppin thinks this game is worth your time.
